text:
sam-partners: Quick sync / kickoff for cloud catalog publish. Need final owners on: publisher role + staging, region manifest, SKU table with co-brand flag, and legal clearance for listing copy. Who's in?

lee-eng: i'll own publisher automation + region manifest. plan: produce manifest.json with region->image and a replicated_at timestamp, plus fallback_image field.

toni-legal: i'll own legal artifacts (EULA excerpt, privacy snippet, export controls). need the customer-facing description to redline. ETA 48 hours after copy lands.

marco-pm: i'll do SKU naming and trial rules. recommended tiers: Free(10k tokens/mo), Trial14, Pro, Enterprise(contact). will add co-brand_required column.

catalog-bot: Staging publisher account provisioned: cloud-catalog-staging (acct 444555666). Attach publisher-role before dry-run.

emma-sales: confirming trial durations and customer names. will post final display strings by EOD. :+1:

lee-eng: putting a tiny verify script here for images: ```bash
REGIONS=(us-east-1 eu-west-1 ap-southeast-1)
for r in "${REGIONS[@]}"; do
  aws ec2 describe-images --region "$r" --image-ids "$AMI_ID" >/dev/null 2>&1 || echo "$AMI_ID missing in $r"
done
```

sam-partners: good. marco - please upload first-pass CSV (sku_id, sku_name, product_id, plan_tier, trial_days, free_quota_tokens, co_brand_required) to the shared sheet.

marco-pm: uploaded -> https://docs.internal/redwood/marketplace-offer-draft. marked two SKUs as co_brand_required.

toni-legal: note: avoid claims about HIPAA/PCI unless we have contracts. also include our SOC2 link and privacy page in listing metadata.

lee-eng: i'll emit manifest snippet like: {"us-east-1":"ami-0a1b2c3d","eu-west-1":"ami-0d4e5f6g","replicated_at":"2026-03-21T16:00:00Z","fallback_image":"ami-0fallback"}

catalog-bot: Reminder: run the dry-run with --dry-run flag in staging to validate fields before publishing to prod.

sam-partners: risks: image replication lag, partner logo approvals, and legal turnarounds. flag now if you expect delays.

emma-sales: partner co-brand approvals may add 48-72 hours if external legal signs are needed. will escalate early when co_brand_required true.

lee-eng: ran image checks: us-east-1 ok, eu-west-1 replicating (ETA 45m), ap-southeast-1 missing -> set fallback. will push manifest to sheet when done.

marco-pm: booked a 30m dry-run for Day 3 11:00. inviting owners and legal.

toni-legal: will attend and bring redlines.

sam-partners: final timeline: Day0 owners, Day1 CSV+manifest, Day2 legal signoff, Day3 staging dry-run, Day4 prod publish. If partner legal needed, shift +2 days.

lee-eng: posting manifest link in the sheet. tagging when ready.

sam-partners: awesome. please update the sheet and ping this thread with the staging dry-run result. :rocket:
